Name: Tahath, Son of Bered
Summary: Son of Bered and father of Eladah in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:20: Son of Bered and father of Eladah in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Tahath stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
